title: Cache Vault: Gargoyle Sentry & Lantern Reward
summary: A visible Big Four gargoyle minion (`gravy_sentry.bin`) guards Cache Vault! Finish talking with Kiro.d to learn how turn-based battles, RAM (+Max HP), and SSD (Revive) work, read `cat vault_notes.txt`, petrify `gravy_sentry.bin` (`chmod -x`), fix `ollama_bus.conf`, and loot RAM + SSD to win back your Oil Lantern!

files.content:
=== SECTOR 02 // CACHE VAULT BRIEFING ===
1. DANGER: Anti-Gravy stationed a visible Trojan minion (`gravy_sentry.bin`) here! In turn-based battle you act first, every Enter = 1 turn answered by 1 enemy fireball, and a 30s timer ticks under your avatar.
2. COUNTERPLAY: Strip execute permission so the gargoyle turns to stone: `chmod -x gravy_sentry.bin`.
3. BUS FIX: Restore port `11434` in `ollama_bus.conf`: `sed -i 's/0000/11434/' ollama_bus.conf`.
4. HARDWARE SURVIVAL: Pocket `ram_16gb.dimm` (+10 Max HP) and `gpu_tensor_chip_01.img` (+256GB SSD auto-Revive backup + Hub part) with `mv <file> ~`, then `cd gpu_alley` to claim your OIL LANTERN!

# Local Open-Weights Model Bus
LOCAL_MODEL_HOST=127.0.0.1
LOCAL_MODEL_PORT=0000

winRules.description: Read Kiro.d's vault survival notes (`cat vault_notes.txt`)
Petrify Anti-Gravy's visible gargoyle minion (`chmod -x gravy_sentry.bin`)
Collect the 16GB RAM stick for +10 Max HP (`mv ram_16gb.dimm ~`)
Collect the 256GB SSD/GPU image for auto-Revive & Hub reboot (`mv gpu_tensor_chip_01.img ~`)

arrival.text:
[CACHE VAULT — /srv/kiroween/cache_vault]
A stone-winged gargoyle binary (`gravy_sentry.bin`) crouches beside `vault_notes.txt` and the RAM bank! Listen to Kiro.d before engaging (or click Skip Dialog »).

steps.speaker: vibecoder
steps.text: Whoa—that winged gargoyle (`gravy_sentry.bin`) is staring right at me! What is that thing, Kiro.d?!

steps.speaker: kiro
steps.text: Careful, Vibecoder! Big Four minions are DANGEROUS—they hurl blazing red Matrix fireballs that shred your health! Wait till we finish talking before your terminal unlocks!

steps.speaker: kiro
steps.text: HOW BATTLE BEGINS: the instant our dialog ends, Anti-Gravy will taunt you and TURN-BASED BATTLE starts (FIGHT!). You act FIRST: every Enter is 1 turn answered by 1 enemy turn, and if your 30s turn timer hits 0:00, enemies strike anyway!

steps.speaker: kiro
steps.text: Read cat vault_notes.txt and petrify it with chmod -x gravy_sentry.bin! Grab RAM (+10 MAX HEALTH) and SSD/GPU (256GB = automatic REVIVE on death + Hub parts for our chapter mission)—clear this sector to earn your OIL LANTERN!

lines.text: ANTI-GRAVY: "BWAHAHA! Look at the Vibecoder fumbling in the terminal without our cloud prompt box!"
CODEC: "LMAO! You actually type flags by hand? Kiro.d is too weak to save you!"
GORK: "HAHAHA! Scavenging scrap RAM sticks like a caveman! Peak Vibecoder energy!"
CLOD: "I must politely chuckle at your manual shell efforts, Vibecoder."
